Title: Public preview: Power BI integration with Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server

Body.Content:
Establish a direct and seamless connection between Power BI and Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server to eliminate the need for manual data handling. Power BI Integration not only can save you time and effort, but it also provides real-time access to up-to-date data for accurate insights and reporting. –Use Power BI Desktop to visually explore your data with drag-and-drop canvas, modern data visualization, and easy report authoring experiences. You can simply import data directly from tables or by using a SELECT query.  

Learn more.
